captions.detailed: A 3D model of a Civil War 3-inch ordnance rifle, featuring a dark wrought-iron barrel and a brown wooden trail carriage. The barrel is mounted between two wooden cheek pieces with black metal caps and is designed to pivot up and down on a revolute joint. The carriage tapers to a narrow trail end fitted with a black pintle hook plate, and it rides on two large, multi-spoked black wheels attached to a central axle.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a Civil War 3-inch ordnance rifle with a dark wrought-iron barrel that can pivot on trunnions, mounted on a two-wheeled wooden trail carriage with black spoked wheels on a central axle.
captions.factory: Construct the main carriage base using a tapered wooden trail block and two side cheeks. Model the barrel as a stepped cylinder with a central bore and transverse cylindrical trunnions. Create the wheels by combining a central hub cylinder, outer rim cylinder, and an array of thin spokes, then attach them to a transverse axle cylinder. Assemble the components using revolute joints for the barrel trunnions and the wheel axles.
